lines.speaker: Mrs. Puffle
lines.text: My spotted hat! I feel like a proper lady again. Thank you, dear.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Puffle
lines.text: Oh, a current snatched my spotted hat right off my head! It drifted all the way up the Jellyfish Fields.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Puffle
lines.text: If you find it, do bring it back. I have a Glimmer Seed I've been saving for someone kind.
